name: codex-design
description: Create interfaces or slides beside your conversation, with a shared project design system, board inspiration, anchored discussions and design-to-code handoff.

interface.longDescription: Ask for interface designs, slide layouts or a project design system to start a shared canvas beside your conversation. Create desktop, laptop, tablet and mobile interfaces with arbitrary-size frames, generate or discover reusable design tokens and rules, collect annotated board inspiration, discuss components in anchored threads, and give your agent the complete design and source for implementation.
defaultPrompt: Design an interface or slide deck on the canvas.
Review design comments and update the current board.
Find the design system in my app and reuse it across boards.
